text:
ana: Small alert from post-launch telemetry: Dedicated routing occasionally adds ~6s to embedding requests for some customers (0.4% of total calls). observed after yesterday's rollout of routing policy v2.
riley: can you surface affected customers & repro steps? is it tied to a model or a routing rule?
ana: typo: ana. affected: two customers on eu-west region using dedicated pools. seems to coincide with fallback to burst nodes when pool is saturated. no clear repro yet.
lee: that smells like cold-start or the new idle-scaler threshold. it might be the new scale-down window we shipped (30s -> 10s).
morgan: product question: do we treat 0.4% latency spike as 'hotfix' (micro-release) or backlog for next sprint? customer visibility matters (both are paying enterprise).
riley: for enterprise customers visible in demo we should prioritize. do we have SLA violations?
ana: ana again: no SLA breach yet (p99 still within limits), but we have churn risk and an upcoming exec demo next Wed for one customer.
lee: mitigation options: 1) revert scaling change (safe, costs up) 2) increase min replicas for dedicated pools for affected customers (targeted) 3) schedule fix in next sprint with improved testing + longer canary
morgan: cost vs speed tradeoff. revert globally is quick but pushes cost. targeted increase in min replicas is low-risk and fast if platform supports per-customer override.
riley: owners? time estimates?
lee: revert: ~30m deploy + monitoring. targeted override: ~2-3h to wire routing + config + deploy. backlog fix (proper root-cause): 3-5d dev + regression testing.
ana: can we do targeted override as temporary, then backlog the real fix? that seems reasonable before the demo.
morgan: agree. update launch criteria doc: add "postdeploy scaling regressions" to must-fix-before-demo if customer-visible. also add a check in the runbook for dedicated pools.
qa-bot: automatic note: Created ticket PL-4982 for targeted override; created test-suite stub: `tests/dedicated_scale/regression_prompts.yaml`
riley: timeline: lee, can you push the override + smoke test today? ana will notify customers about a short targeted config change and the plan.
lee: starting the work now. will post the override command and smoke results in thread.
morgan: backlog grooming note: add a card to next sprint to instrument idle-scaler telemetry per-customer and add a canary scheme for scaling param changes. owner: platform infra.
nana: ana again: also adding a small prompt bank to launch criteria: one check per deployment that simulates dedicated pools under burst and verifies no >2s tail increase.
riley: thanks. decision: targeted override (temporary) -> monitor 48h -> decide full fix in next sprint if dup incidents. owners: lee (override), ana (customer comms), morgan (launch criteria update).
lee: override applied: `redwood config set --customer=acct-342 --min-replicas=2` smoke: p50 normal, p99 reduced from 6.1s -> 1.8s on sample runs.
nana: will message customers and mention this is temporary and we plan full root-cause fix next sprint.
qa-bot: test run: PASS (sample bank 12/12). adding to INF board link: https://console.redwood/boards/PL-4982
morgan: final: add to micro-release list? it's a targeted infra tweak, no code change. i'll add to micro-release notes and update postlaunch checklist.
riley: cool, closing loop. we'll re-evaluate in 48h at Tue 10:00.
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from morgan)
